title: Decode the unowned region-owner sentinel instead of persisting -1
summary: Liberation persisted the in-band -1 sentinel as a region's durable owner_faction_id, crashing the authoritative pipeline with KeyError(-1) at town_resolution.py:136 on a later tax tick. Named the sentinel and decoded it in one place; wired at the apply boundary and both observability payload sites. Crash reproduced end-to-end before fixing; 3 positive-controlled tests.

title: Close decision-only: two ownership writers stay, precedence documented, consolidation deferred
summary: Premise measured false: 0 same-tick overlaps in ~48,000 region-ticks and 0 ownership writes from the death-gated writer, so the shape is an undocumented precedence between two producers of one field, not two conflicting live values. Closed decision-only, no src/ change. Documented the precedence, the last-tick influence read and the non-emitting writer in the runtime contract; WORLD-107 gained the evidence. Resolved the decisive phase-ordering question as NOT ADDRESSED and unobstructed.
